newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kilpatrick Green named as govt unit buyer.
newsitem.headline: Kilpatrick Green named as govt unit buyer.

text.p: The Australian government on Monday named engineering group Kilpatrick Green Holdings Ltd as the preferred buyer for government customer co-ordinator and contractor, Australian Operational Support Services (AOSS).
The company is one of six business units to be sold as part of an Administrative Services Department privatisation plan announced in the budget in August 1996.
Finance Minister John Fahey and Administrative Services Minister David Jull said in a joint statement the sale price would be announced when the contracts were exchanged in a few weeks.

Kilpatrick Green operates in Australia, New Zealand and South East Asia and its activities include design and engineering in fields such as power generation, water systems and waste treatment, and communications.
In a separate statement, Kilpatrick Green said the contracts acquired with AOSS have a combined turnover of about A$60 million over the next two to five years.
